## About
Ace Paintless Dent Repair is a dent repair shop on N Stemmons Fwy in Lewisville. Hugh and his team work on hail damage and dents with paintless dent repair, and they also handle auto body work.
Customers rate us 4.8 on Google from 98 reviews. One reviewer called Hugh an old school man of his word who stands behind his work. Another said the team is transparent and honest about what to expect.

## Services
- Paintless dent repair: Dents taken out without repainting, so your car keeps its original finish.
- Hail damage repair: Hail dents repaired with paintless dent repair. One reviewer said his Tesla came back looking spotless.
- Auto body work: Body work beyond dent repair, according to one longtime customer.

## FAQ
Q: Can you fix hail damage?
A: Yes. We repair hail damage with paintless dent repair, and one reviewer said his car looked new afterward.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

A: We're at 810 N Stemmons Fwy, Lewisville, TX 75057.
